summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and interim report for the period ended September 30, 2026. Net earnings were $929.6 million ($43.32 per diluted share) versus $1,151.7 million a year earlier; book value per basic share rose to $1,349.15 from $1,260.19, up 8.4% adjusting for the $15 per-share dividend. P&C operations posted $1,375.0 million adjusted operating income and a 92.5% undiscounted combined ratio. No transaction, tender, activist or structural event is disclosed; this is ordinary periodic reporting.
